title: Gradient-Normalized Smoothness for Optimization with Approximate Hessians

split.decision: 用户决定 none 转 synthetic：val 为 seed 3124 与 2718；train 为 seed 42；test 为 secrets 隐藏 seed 的5个实例。相同 RandomState 生成与中心化；种子只在私有记录。

baseline.paper_ref: Reproduced public instance: 17; paper panel not numerically matched.

allowed_changes: The optimizer, search strategy, Hessian approximation and preconditioner may change through the frozen oracle. Surrogates may guide the solver but cannot replace its evaluated objective.
fixed_contract: Reach the specified accuracy for the fixed centered LogSumExp problem within its oracle-query budgets.
The centered LogSumExp(Ax-b) objective with mu=1, supplied 1000 by 500 A and b, and all-ones initialization remain fixed.
The first gap at most 1e-7, horizon 500, at most 25 gradient calls and at most 24 charged inverses remain fixed. All accepted iterates and rejected-query costs must be recorded.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Any point from which a new search direction is computed is an accepted iterate and must be recorded, so the inner steps of a nested, proximal or multi-step solver cannot be grouped under one recorded iteration.
Do not use the origin, f(0) or the iterate x_k itself as a step, search direction or subspace basis; the stopping test is the only permitted use of f(0).

Do not replace the mathematical objective/initialization, bypass counters, suppress accepted iterates, introduce uncounted derivative/inverse calls, or exploit knowledge of the synthetic optimum instead of the allowed oracle.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
